trackerLog.subject: Framefield

bug.title: Draw preview size does not match committed object when zoomed in
bug.repro: Zoom in. Draw. Watch ghost. Release.
bug.expected: Committed geometry matches the live stroke in world units at any camera scale.
bug.actual: Ghost is correct. On pointer-up the object is the wrong size and/or appears on the wrong stack.
bug.notes: Two coordinate paths: preview uses camera, commit stores screen deltas. One screenToWorld for ghost and node.create. Stroke in world units. COMP-008. Related to BUG-002.

bug.title: Shapes tool still draws at the wrong scale for a very small square
bug.repro: Zoom in. Shapes tool. Drag a very small square. Compare ghost to committed shape.
bug.expected: The committed square matches the ghost in world units, including tiny sizes.
bug.actual: Small square commits at the wrong scale (too large or too small vs the preview).
bug.notes: Same family as BUG-001, shapes path, small-size edge. Suspect min size in screen pixels applied as world units, integer rounding of world coords, or a coarse snap grid. Do not clamp width/height in CSS pixels. Store float64 world size. Verify at default zoom and deep zoom. COMP-008, COMP-009.

trackerLog.decision: Implementation is a separate thread. This chat is features and bugs.
Functionality first. Multi-writer is Phase 5.
Centered square world, 3/5 default zoom, Y-up. Negative coordinates allowed.
DXF first-class. DWG through a licensed converter.
Phase 1.5 nested spaces. Do not lower link precision (float64).
Phase 2 presence is an overlay with toggle and transparency.
Stacking is layerId + order, not a GPU depth buffer. Compatible with Phase 2 layers.
Dev mode on by default through Phase 2. Flags visible with descriptions. Checkerboard debug ground for new spaces.
Build phase-by-phase. Do not ask one chat for 1.5 + Grok + DXF in the first reply.
Phase 1.1 freezes chrome names, tokens, reserved docks, operation type strings.
This chat does not modify application source. Tracker files only.
Grok owns the tracker. No intake paste required.
Inspector in professional mode acknowledges selection with empty property slots (FEAT-020).
Shared log is Framefield_Tracker.json. HTML is the view. Impl and design both write the JSON.
Do not start SET-1.5 while transform/commit still uses screen space.
Do not turn on SET-2.0c (Grok) if SET-1.2 and SET-1.6 are incomplete.
Layers (SET-1.6) ship before Grok so ghosts land on a real layer.
After 2.0: Phase 3 scripts/animatic/share, Phase 4 optional second model + stamps, Phase 5 multi-writer.
commitPlan20 is true. Feature sets through 2.0 are on the tracker.
trackerLog.note: Web vector storyboard canvas. Grok draws and the user edits. Infinite (then nested-true-infinite) field. Import/export. Optional ChatGPT later. Server storage later.
Imported objects need management: role, replace, detach, relink, crop, versions — not a one-shot drop.
Checkpoint every 60s if dirty, and on every major action. Live drags and camera are not saves. Shape kept for later multi-writer.
Live multi-writer deferred. Functionality first. Presence (see others) is Phase 2; writing together is Phase 5.
DXF native. DWG only via licensed server conversion. Other vectors (SVG) in Phase 1. Y-up: flip once at screen, never twice on import.
Start 3/5 inward on a log scale because users zoom out as they draw. Perfect square world. Origin at center so negative coords exist. Maximize 64-bit usage inside ±1e8 in Phase 1.
Document truth is layerId + sparse order. GPU depth is not stacking. UI chrome uses --ui-z-* bands. Presence is not a user layer. Phase 2 layer UI must not rewrite the Phase 1 schema.

Phase 1.5: no max zoom. Cross Sin → child space at focus, new origin, nest+1, checkerboard while debugging. Cross Sout → parent, or insert a parent at root. Objects stay in the space where created. Portal mark at child origin.
Do not lower precision on space links. float64 for origins, scaleToParent, camera rewrite. Never float16. Never one global float32 zoom. Product-to-root is display-only in the dev panel.
On by default through Phase 2. Side panel: space, camera, precision (ulp, max |coord|, distance to spawn), stack, flags with one-line descriptions, editable.
No sales handoff. Same model, new or same thread. One phase per prompt. Use Framefield_Build_Brief.md. Start Phase 1 only.
Region ids, tokens, tool ids, reserved inspector tabs and docks (mounted hidden), operation type strings, reserved project fields (styleCard, pinnedAssetIds, schemaVersion). Hide, do not delete.
Discussion and bugs only. Do not modify application source here. Tracker files are the only writes.
Canonical file artifacts/Framefield_Tracker.json. HTML polls it. Impl sets status; design files bugs and plans. Both bump revision.
Draw tool ghost correct when zoomed; committed object wrong size and/or wrong stack. Fix: one screenToWorld for preview and node.create.
Professional mode: selecting an object shows inspector and empty property slots. Do not populate values in 1.1. Acknowledge selection.
Sets 1.0 → 1.1 → 1.2 → 1.3 → 1.4 → 1.5 → 1.6 → 2.0a presence → 2.0b style → 2.0c Grok. BUG-001 and BUG-002 are gates on 1.0, 1.2, 1.5, and 2.0c.
Shapes tool, very small square, still wrong scale vs ghost. Treat as small-size edge of the same world/screen bug; also check pixel min-size and integer rounding.
